name: combinatorial-identities
title: Combinatorial identities and counting
summary: Prove binomial sums, Fibonacci identities, closed forms of linear recurrences, and counting arguments with injections and pigeonholes.

name: definitions
title: Definitions from words
summary: Turn a number-theoretic definition written in words into a computable Lean function that agrees with it on hidden inputs.

name: finite-sums
title: Closed forms for finite sums
summary: Prove a closed form for a finite sum: polynomial, geometric or telescoping, by induction on the number of terms.

name: group-theory
title: Proofs about groups and subgroups
summary: Prove facts about abstract groups: commutativity from exponent laws, inverses, subgroup membership and Lagrange, homomorphism kernels.
skill: Group identities and the Subgroup API

name: inequalities
title: Inequalities over the reals
summary: Prove real inequalities: AM-GM, Cauchy-Schwarz, absolute values and monotone functions, with hints, case splits and lemma reuse.

name: linear-algebra
title: Proofs about matrices and vector spaces
summary: Prove facts about 2x2 matrices, matrix powers, linear independence of explicit vectors, and kernels, ranges and projections of linear maps.
skill: Matrix computation and linear map API

name: logic-and-sets
title: Logic and set algebra
summary: Prove set identities and image statements, Finset cardinality facts and equivalence relations.

name: modular-arithmetic
title: Divisibility, congruences and parity
summary: Prove facts about residues, divisibility, congruences and coprimality for natural numbers and integers, by case analysis on residues.

name: real-analysis
title: Real analysis with epsilon and delta
summary: Prove limits of explicit sequences, epsilon-delta continuity, bounds on recursive sequences and uniform bounds, from the definitions.
skill: Epsilon-delta arguments and induction on real sequences
